description: Write a Python ETL script using pandas that performs incremental loading of transaction data. The script should: (1) read the high-water mark (last processed timestamp) from a state file, (2) load only new records from a CSV source where transaction_timestamp > high_water_mark, (3) apply transformations: convert amounts from cents to dollars, parse ISO timestamps to UTC datetime, categorize transactions by amount ranges, (4) deduplicate by transaction_id keeping the latest version, (5) append to the target Parquet file, (6) update the high-water mark.
edge_cases: Timezone-aware timestamps: +05:00 must be converted to UTC before comparison
Deduplication: tx_001 appears twice, keep the latest (reversed status)
Amount categorization boundaries: micro (<$1), small ($1-$100), medium ($100-$1000), large (>=$1000)
Empty source file (no new records): script should not fail
State file missing on first run: start from epoch
common_failure_modes: FM2: Comparing timezone-naive high_water_mark with timezone-aware timestamps
FM5: Parquet append losing schema on first write
